We are proud to partner with the Sanjeeva Singh Archery Institute Trust (SSAIT) to establish the Axis Bank Sanjeeva Singh Olympic Archery Centre in Kanhauli, Eastern Uttar Pradesh, a first-of-its-kind initiative that will create India's first fully integrated Olympic-standard archery centre in a rural setting.

Designed to bridge the gap between grassroots talent and international sporting excellence, the Centre will bring together world-class training infrastructure, sports science, residential facilities and education on a single campus. It will feature Olympic-standard indoor and outdoor ranges, advanced performance analytics, athlete development systems, and accommodation for resident athletes. 

Led by Olympian and Dronacharya Awardee Sanjeeva Singh, the initiative aims to expand access to high-performance sporting infrastructure for talented young athletes from underserved regions and create a sustainable pathway to elite competition. 

Aligned with India's vision of strengthening its Olympic ecosystem, the Centre is expected to support around 100 resident athletes annually while hosting over 300 Indian and international athletes through training camps, competitions and high-performance programmes. 

At Axis Bank, we believe that access and opportunity can unlock extraordinary potential. Through this partnership, we hope to help nurture the next generation of archers and contribute to India's sporting aspirations on the global stage.
